items.q: What should you remember about **Non-technical background is not a blocker**?
items.a: **15 years in email HTML/CSS,** not "real" development; Claude Code "looks technical but is absolutely non-technical.".

items.q: What should you remember about **Start from your domain**?
items.a: **don't learn AI in the** abstract; ask how AI makes you faster at work you already do.

items.q: What should you remember about **Learning path: Zapier → Make → n8n → Claude Code**?
items.a: **n8n + ChatGPT side-by-side for** node-by-node builds; AIS course pivoted from n8n into Claude Code.

items.q: What should you remember about **Show yourself beats perfect**?
items.a: **Hormozi mantra; terrified first talk (90+** people) on n8n for non-technical users became LinkedIn proof and interview leverage.

items.q: What should you remember about **Build in public with zero followers**?
items.a: **two YouTube channels (English +** Spanish), consistent LinkedIn; views/subscribers don't matter — links and your face do.

items.q: What should you remember about **"What have you built?" is the hiring filter**?
items.a: **HR's email question; video** demos separated her from ChatGPT-written cover letters.

items.q: What should you remember about **Selective applications**?
items.a: **~10 targeted roles, not** spray-and-pray; research the company and propose specific ideas in interviews.

items.q: What should you remember about **Head of AI = strategy + builds + hiring**?
items.a: **not a pure executive** seat; stay hands-on because the space changes daily.

items.q: What should you remember about **Two-week strategic trial**?
items.a: **CEO trial focused on hotel vertical**: map opportunities, prioritize quick wins, propose what not to automate.

items.q: What should you remember about **Adoption framing**?
items.a: **"I'm not replacing anyone"; remove** boring repetitive work, not whole jobs; culture shift, not a quarterly workshop.

items.q: What should you remember about **4 a.m. learning block**?
items.a: **structured daily practice before family/day job interruptions.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Outsource thinking, not understanding**?
items.a: **use AI for paths** and research; human owns trade-offs and final decisions.
